# FieldKind

Namespace `AutoSettings.Sdk` · enum

```csharp
public enum FieldKind
```

The type of a field, which decides how it is checked and which control the editor shows.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `String` | One line of text. |
| `Multiline` | Several lines of text. |
| `Path` | A file or folder path (the editor shows a Browse button). |
| `Integer` | A whole number. Use [`FieldAttribute.Minimum`](FieldAttribute.md#minimum) and [`FieldAttribute.Maximum`](FieldAttribute.md#maximum) for limits. |
| `Number` | A number with decimals. |
| `Boolean` | Yes or no. |
| `Enum` | One of [`FieldAttribute.Values`](FieldAttribute.md#values). |
| `Duration` | A duration such as `30s` or `1h30m`. |
| `Time` | A time of day such as `22:00`. |
| `StringList` | A list of text. If [`FieldAttribute.Values`](FieldAttribute.md#values) is set, each item must be one of them. |
| `AppList` | A list of apps (exe names or paths); the editor shows an app picker. |
| `UserList` | A list of user names; the editor shows a user picker. |
